testcase.name: Scenario: Open the Sketch Create panel expansion: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open the Sketch Create panel expansion ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with `Sketch1` being edited in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Sketch ribbon is expanded and the Create panel is visible ✔ And the Create panel's additional command area is closed ✔ When the user selects the expansion arrow on the Create panel title ✔ Then an additional command area opens below that panel over the workspace ✔ And the Create Block command is visible ✔ And Precise Input is visible but unavailable in this captured state ✔ And the sketch and model browser remain visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the Create additional command area remains open ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the Create additional command area closes ✔ And the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
